name: Alan Scott Enterprises Ltd
tagline: Loss-making acquisition roll-up with deeply negative ROE and eroding net worth - fundamentals disqualify it regardless of the price trend
business_overview: Alan Scott Enterprises / Industries (incorporated 1994) manufactures health and hygiene products for hospitals and homes, and has expanded via rapid subsidiary/acquisition accumulation. Promoter holding ~63.5%.
fundamentals_narrative: The business is loss-making with a ~ -88.7% three-year ROE - i.e. sustained losses eroding net worth - on shrinking revenue (~Rs 34 Cr) and a demanding ~16-17x price-to-book. The legacy screen documented losses in every one of the last four quarters, negative free cash flow, high borrowing cost and an active rights issue; the acquisition-driven 5-year sales CAGR is a low-quality growth signal. Current data confirms the picture has not improved.
